prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1318; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had stopped briefly at the light and then proceeded when my signal turned green for the turn. The impact was strong enough to jolt my car and push it partway into the turning lane. I have given the same account of what happened every time I have described it, to the other driver, to the responding officer, and to my insurer. Afterward I felt stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, which I have since been treating with my doctor. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed. I am happy to provide any additional information that would help.
